Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment

For 3845 N Whipple St, Chicago, IL 60618
From RS-3 to RT-3.5

1.A. The applicant seeks a zoning change from RS-3 zoning district to an RT-3.5
zoning district to meet the bulk and density standards of the RT-3.5 zoning district
to allow a proposed third story addition to the existing two-story single-family
residence with a detached 2-car garage. The proposed height after the addition
will be 35 feet. The applicant will also seek a variation per Section 17-13-1101-B
to reduce the required north side setback to 0.83’, the south side setback to 3.5’,
and the combined side setback to 4.53’ in order to allow the new addition to be
built along the existing building lines.

* Per Section 17-13-1101-B: Applicant seeks a variation to reduce the required north side
setback to match the existing north side setback of 0.83’, the required south side setback
to meet the existing south side setback of 3.5’, and the required combined side setback to
meet the existing 4.53 ft.
